scope: Design audit of the supplied Computational Matter Zoo Notion snapshot; no simulation, experimental validation, or external mutation performed.

source.treatment: Preserve source text and section anchors. The research program's proposals and named intellectual connections remain source assertions, not independently verified results.

recommendedEntryPoint.title: Computational Matter Zoo
recommendedEntryPoint.defaultBenchmark: One declared 2D breathing-Kagome linear spring model, followed by separately implemented tight-binding and photonic models.
recommendedEntryPoint.rationale: The source offers three alternative starting physics models. Select one per executable run; do not pool their parameter vectors, spectra, units, or validation claims.

phases.title: One executable baseline
phases.gate: Known geometry, boundary conditions, operator, units, solver checks, and reproducible baseline output.

phases.title: Controlled diversity search
phases.gate: Frozen descriptors, archive grid and budgets; negative/control candidates; matched random-search baseline.

phases.title: Descriptor and schema challenges
phases.gate: Held-out robustness and explanatory tests justify migration; no retroactive silent relabeling.

phases.title: Richer physics and fidelity
phases.gate: Each new physical coupling is explicitly modeled and checked before a cross-domain claim.

mechanical.operators: K, M and damping D; K phi = omega^2 M phi. For the declared harmonic convention, mechanical response may use (-omega^2 M + i omega D + K)^(-1). Use distinct names B_in and C_out for input/readout maps.
requirements: Declare translational-only springs versus rotational beam degrees of freedom.
Separate rigid translations, mechanisms, numerical near-zero modes and unstable negative eigenvalues.
Prestress requires force equilibrium and a consistent tangent stiffness, including geometric contributions.
A linear time-invariant spring model does not demonstrate hysteresis, nonlinear gates or higher-order mode coupling.

tight_binding.operators: H with declared orbital basis and units; Green function (E + i eta - H - Sigma(E))^(-1).
requirements: For closed Hermitian models use reciprocal conjugate hoppings and check Hermiticity.
Specify oriented loop phases modulo 2 pi; a gauge-dependent bond phase alone is not a physical flux descriptor.
Transmission requires explicit leads/self-energies and port normalization.
An abstract tight-binding calculation does not establish electronic transport or realizability in an MXene or moire material.

photonic_coupled_mode.operators: A separately declared temporal or propagation coupled-mode operator; identify whether the independent variable is time or propagation distance.
requirements: Couplings can carry inverse-length or inverse-time units according to formulation; do not call all eigenvalues mechanical frequencies.
Loss/gain, reciprocity, bandwidth and effective-model assumptions must be declared.
An engineered phase or nonlocal coupling requires an implementation mechanism; an arbitrary complex matrix is only a model proposal.

future_domains.promotionGate: A domain-specific model, inputs, observable definitions, numerical verification and validation scope must exist before it can produce a claimed result.

crossDomainBoundaries: A shared graph or matrix shape is a comparison interface, not a physical equivalence or a verified transfer map.
The full source parameter list is a tagged union across physics models, not one simultaneously meaningful mechanical design vector.
Mechanical mass normalization, electronic wavefunction normalization and photonic power normalization require explicit maps before quantitative descriptor comparison.
A static passive real spring stiffness matrix cannot implement arbitrary hopping phases; any gyroscopic, active or modulated mechanism needs its own equations.
Tiny impurities can strongly alter a simulated response, but no source-import step establishes useful material behavior or fabrication feasibility.
descriptorAndClaimChecks: IPR is basis- and normalization-sensitive; record treatment of variable masses, degenerate subspaces, finite size and edge support.
A flat band or a localized eigenmode alone does not establish topology, robust memory or controllable readout.
Topological invariants need their valid symmetry class, gap, geometry and calculation; boundary-state plots are insufficient alone.
Group velocity needs a defined periodic dispersion; do not assign it to every finite disordered mode.
Lifetime and Q need damping or leakage; an undamped eigensolve does not measure either.
Resolvent SVD depends on input/output definitions, units, weighting and frequency broadening. High rank alone does not imply independent useful computations.
Pseudospectral behavior must be interpreted in its operator norm and physical metric. Strong nonnormal transient claims need a nonnormal model and time-domain checks.
Compare perturbation efficiency using a fixed, dimensionally declared norm and minimum denominators; avoid ratios dominated by numerical noise.
Archive occupancy is diversity under declared descriptors; it is not evidence of physical novelty, broad utility or a new universality class.
Protect decoupling as an explicit design objective alongside coupling, with matched functional and robustness tests for both.

rules: An imported plan starts as planned/proposed; do not manufacture measured values or completed runs.
Never count a solver error as physical falsification.
Keep failed runs and contradicted hypotheses with hashes, logs and scope; supersede instead of deleting.
Separate quality, diversity, validity, numerical confidence and physical validation tier.
Human or agent opinions can rank interestingness but cannot upgrade evidence tier.

deliverables: baseline and paired intervention CandidateDesign records
acceptance: Domain tags and units are complete
baseline and control differ only by declared intervention

deliverables: residual, symmetry, stability and convergence checks
acceptance: reject invalid eigensolves before archive eligibility

deliverables: baseline MAP-Elites versus matched random-search comparison
empty-niche and tradeoff report with candidate IDs
acceptance: Fixed initial descriptors and equal evaluation budgets
no computation claim from modal count alone

deliverables: tested verdict or executable discriminating test plan
acceptance: Distinguish topology from ordinary localization and finite-size artifacts
test both rare-coupling and protected-decoupling explanations

deliverables: SchemaProposal with counterexamples and held-out prediction
explicit migration/compatibility map and re-indexing plan
acceptance: Novel dimension must add stable predictive or discriminating value
no relabeling old results as independently validated discoveries

inputs: material and fabrication constraints if available
deliverables: Higher-fidelity validation or physical experiment plan
acceptance: Separate simulation evidence from fabrication feasibility
state required material data and unavailable capabilities
do not claim execution before RunRecord/measurement artifacts exist

coordinationPolicy.orthogonality: These roles inspect different failure axes; all may use the same model family and are not statistically independent replicates. Deliberate review overlap is required at domain boundaries.
taskHandshake: read input hashes and schema versions
handoff to a different review role
human gate for scientific promotion or schema change
coordinationPolicy.scopeGuard: Task execution must be capability-aware. Creating these task packets does not run unavailable physics software or fabricate experimental capabilities.

presheafConnection.localSection: Scoped typed claims plus their exact model/run/descriptor versions and evidence references.
presheafConnection.restriction: Projection to shared variables with retained units, scope and provenance; no information-adding restriction.
presheafConnection.overlap: Agreement on the same model identity, boundary conditions, coordinates, normalization and parameter meaning; matching words alone do not establish overlap.
presheafConnection.gluingGate: A merged candidate claim needs all applicable cross-context constraints, not just pairwise keyword compatibility.
presheafConnection.copresheafUse: Track typed artifact availability and schema inclusion; distinguish an existing artifact index from a claim that an inference or experiment occurred.
presheafConnection.schemaEvolution: Version schemas and transfer contracts explicitly. A new type or descriptor is a proposal until its migration and scientific discrimination tests pass.
presheafConnection.limitation: This is a proposed organization for expansion. It does not certify scientific sheaf gluing, derive a universal physical theory, or compute cohomology.
